address_semantics.meaning: Ten-slot selected-interface dispatcher. This address is not the lower station association state machine. Stop 0x6603 and configuration 0x660f broadcast; stop exits on first handler returning one. Other supported messages select a slot directly or by active socket lookup.
Five-state AP_SOC socket service dispatcher with table at 0x013ee430. State storage is incoming-message base plus 0x16c plus four times slot.
Three-state transfer dispatcher with table at 0x013ee924. Transfer state storage is incoming-message base plus 0x194 plus four times slot.
Primary and secondary socket result stores, destructive takes, primary clear. Each take clears both returned words.
AP lookup scans ten slots and only considers socket states above two. Station lookup returns the station slot when its socket state is above two, without comparing the supplied handle.
First selected slot remains selected. A different slot cannot publish. Publication includes socket count, connection-enabled flag, normalized device kind, 32-byte name and six-byte address.
Default listener request uses port 0xd9bc, slot and flags, and four source-bound completion registrations. The request enqueues task87, rather than directly opening a socket.
Open completion emits kind 0x6610 with normalized status 0 or -255, logical slot and socket handle.
